name: Jibhar
title: David's son born in Jerusalem
summary: Jibhar was one of King David's sons, born in Jerusalem after David had conquered the city and made it his capital. He is mentioned in the genealogies of David's sons but plays no prominent role in the biblical narratives beyond this. His name means 'he chooses' or 'the chosen one'.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's sons in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Jibhar is listed among the sons born to David in Jerusalem after he became king over all Israel.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the genealogy of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Jibhar is mentioned again in the detailed list of David's sons in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's large family in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Jibhar is part of the list of sons David had in Jerusalem, showing David's growing dynasty after he became king over all Israel.

keyEvents.title: David's conquest of Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: David's conquest of Jerusalem and establishing the city as his capital was the context for Jibhar's birth, as David took more wives and had more sons and daughters there.
